title: Authored-judgment record — the shared as-of human-judgment shape (annotations / gate-exemptions / image-acceptance)
description: Codifies the convention already carried informally (no schema until now) by monitor/annotations.json, monitor/gate-exemptions.json, and monitor/image-acceptance.json (accepted[]). All three are append-only logs of HUMAN judgments applied AS-OF `at` by rollup.mjs (matcher extracted to annotate-lib.mjs). The core is {match-fields, action, reason, who, at, expires?}; the match-fields differ per surface (findings vs gates vs images) and are captured as three variants. This schema ALSO defines the NEW forward-looking `disposition` field (HITL triage) as a field STRICTLY SEPARATE from the replay-critical `action` field — see the two enums below. Extend HERE; do not re-inline these enums at the read sites. Validation is structural (validate-authored-judgment.mjs, no AJV dependency — mirrors how status-enum.json/lifecycle-record.schema.json are self-scan references, not runtime-validated).

action.description: HISTORICAL as-of judgment. rollup.mjs replays this by timestamp to recolor past slices, so its value MUST be time-stable and meaningful when applied to an OLD slice. The suppressing subset {accept, false-positive, wont-fix, incorrect-scan-result} drops a finding from open counts (annotate-lib.mjs SUPPRESSING_ACTIONS); incorrect-scan-result blames the INSTRUMENT rather than judging the subject, and REQUIRES a defect object naming it ({tool, detail, detector?, fixedIn?}) so the suppression can be checked rather than taken on trust. It is time-stable and therefore safe to replay onto an old slice: the detector was as broken then as now; `note`/`resolved` annotate without suppressing; `exempt` is the gate-overlay verb. NEVER put a `disposition` value here — 'as-of urg-remediate' is meaningless for recoloring history (breakers finding #3).

disposition.description: NEW — FORWARD-LOOKING triage state (HITL remediation queue). 'what we intend to do next', not 'what we decided about the past'. NOT replayed as-of; represents current intent only. Drives the disposition triage layer in timeline2. Held in its OWN field so it can never contaminate the `action` replay (schema forbids overlap). `urg-remediate` = the loud/urgent lane.

provenance.description: The who/at/(expires) discipline shared by all three surfaces. `at` is the as-of lower bound; `expires` (optional) is the exclusive upper bound that reverts the judgment to open. `recheckTrigger` is image-acceptance's named re-evaluation condition (a semantic sibling of expires).

reason.description: Human rationale — why this judgment. Required on every record (never-imply-clean: an unexplained suppression is a lie).

who.description: Author/authorizer. NOT the escalation recipient (that is bugReportedTo in the finding record).

at.description: UTC ISO — as-of lower bound. Replaying a slice earlier than `at` shows the judgment NOT yet in force.

expires.description: Optional UTC ISO — exclusive upper bound; after it the judgment reverts to open. Set this to RETIRE a judgment; never delete the record (append-only).

recheckTrigger.description: image-acceptance only — named condition that re-opens the acceptance (e.g. 'next postgres:18.x patch tag'). Semantic sibling of expires.

oneOf.title: finding-annotation (monitor/annotations.json)
oneOf.description: Match {id,package,repo} AND-ed, omitted key = wildcard (annotate-lib.mjs annMatch). action from the shared enum.

id.description: CVE/GHSA/CWX id. Omitted = wildcard across ids.

gate.description: Manifest check id: qg-boot-test | qg-contract-tests | qg-openapi | qg-ci | qg-boot-test-pass.

oneOf.title: image-acceptance (monitor/image-acceptance.json accepted[])
oneOf.description: Match {image,cve,package}. The risk-acceptance HALF is the authored judgment (reachability + containment + recheckTrigger); the fixStatus/pin half is machine-derivable and out of this schema's judgment scope.

fixStatus.description: Machine-derivable half (not the judgment): no-fix-exists | fix-exists-not-applied | ...

reachability.description: The judgment: why this residual is (in)accessible in role. Human risk call — no scan asserts it.

containment.description: Control ids (C1..Cn) from image-acceptance.json controls that neutralize the residual.
